focuses.description: The big guy always fears the little guy and vice versa, through this we must cut back on the conscription of our young men and women into the military and encourage more domestic based livings for our people. This should placate the upper strata while also making the lower strata feel more accomplished without feeling like they have to do something drastic like lay their life on the line.

focuses.name: Saving For A Suit And Hat
focuses.description: The burden of those pressured into this supposed need to go to college is fundamentally wrong. We must reduce gov't intervention in high end education and reform the way on how people can get a job and the ability to gain that working experience.

focuses.name: The Economic Backbone
focuses.description: The backbone of the economy has always been the mom & pop shops which liter the streets of this nation. We must change some regulation to allow their expansion and their ease of foundation, granting these new breaths of fresh air we expect a rise in productivity as people are better supported by their job places.

focuses.name: Searing The Fake Act
focuses.description: Many foreign investments on our soil have come with built in between the lines kind of measures. With this knowledge we will attack this issue head on and while it may not be entirely a net positive, it will surely keep the sanctity of our nation alive and well amid foreign meddling.

focuses.name: A Reformed Economy
focuses.description: The nation is at its peak of reform for the times at hand, while we still have work to do it is nevertheless a future of prosperity and pride for the people and the nation as a whole. The confidence our population has in the domestic situation is near mirrored by the tenacity and vigor our folks in the military show with their recent effectiveness tests in war games and exercises held these last couple of years. A dawn is upon the nation, a dawn of a new era.

focuses.name: A Truly Reformed Republic
focuses.description: With the winds passing and the calm setting in, one wonders what could be on the horizon for such a rise, then fall and now a rise yet again. Though we feel accomplished the work is never truly done and it is as such that we must look to the future and to those who look to us for help and guidance. We must look back and we must help them in whatever way we can as we have been able to help ourselves.

focuses.name: Tackling Blue Tape Administration
focuses.description: The Democrats of the Duopoly have seen fit to over encumber the administrative wings of every program, while we can't do everything at once we can get the biggest problem. The US healthcare system.

focuses.name: Dealing With Donkey Welfare
focuses.description: Our administration campaign is on-going. With the healthcare taken care of we switch to welfare, where the administrations of nearly all programs in incumbered by back and forthing responsibilities, regulations and rules its no wonder so much unrest has gripped the older folks against the younger generation.

focuses.name: Compromising Red Tape Deregulation
focuses.description: The Republicans were too pro-big business, we understand that business is good, but not all business is good. We should begin a 2nd campaign, one which reverts power from Wall Street and puts it back to those living and working on Main Street.

focuses.name: Dealing With Red Security
focuses.description: The supposed Grand Old Party seems to have a Grand Ole time hiking up military spending and internal security spending which has taken away needed money for the betterment of the people. If we cut things related to the MIC recruitment efforts and some more heavy handed programs in our internal security apparatus, the people will still feel just as safe if not safer and on top of that will know that their money isn't all going towards potentially dubious ventures.

focuses.name: Balancing Education Needs
focuses.description: The back and forthing between red and blue education reforms has seen a quagmire and severe decline in the quality of education in this country. We must look at both sides of the aisle and properly digest and combine the two side dishes into one main course so our youth can enjoy a full learning meal for their brains and their future prospects.

focuses.name: Democratic Care Reform
focuses.description: Though the DNC is not the best well rounded party, their ideas in healthcare were on a somewhat right track. We must fine tune this venture and understand what real good can come from the current system.

focuses.name: Education Baseline Act
focuses.description: The EBA will look at how we introduce and teach our youth when they first enter the education system. From there we will reform and better standardize on a national level the key things these young ones should be learning, numbers, letters and early adoption of social skills when working together and independently.

focuses.name: Military Modernism
focuses.description: With the avenue of war itself changing we must look to change with it, to do so we must invest in our soldiers, giving them the skills to man modern aircraft and able to plan in rapidly changing scenarios.

focuses.name: A Victory For The Constitution
focuses.description: The duopoly of the Red and the Blue is truly at an end. With this victory we stand fast to fix the negligence of those who stray from our founding principles. Victory for the Rhino. Victory for the founding fathers. Victory, for the constitution.

focuses.name: Reinforcing The Living Document
focuses.description: The Constitution, the document which founded this fair nation is the rule of law. We are a Constitutional Republic and thus we must go hard in making this a certainty to those who wish to undermine it. Therefore a federal mandated legislation shall be created solidifying this mere fact, making it punishable by fine and or imprisonment for those who directly and maliciously attempt to undermine our founding document.

focuses.name: Shaving Left Wing Excesses
focuses.description: The modern liberal has seen to deface and outright ignore the values of our great nation's constitution. They have passed legislation and created a status-quo of acceptance that throwing the constitution out as a viable alternative. We will reverse these changes and fix the decaying American Dream.

focuses.name: Shaving Fake Right Wing Fodder
focuses.description: The supposed right wing of this nation is filled with rabble and outright fakes. These neocons as they have been dubbed and their offspring of ideologues, seek to lie to the citizenry of our nation and undermine our founding principles with these lofty ideas that only the government can solve the problem. We see through this treason and will work tooth and nail to reverse and fix these changes. Starting with the government subsidies of major corporations.

focuses.name: De-Looping The Holes
focuses.description: The Tax code of this nation is a mess, overlapping budgets, inefficiencies in allocation and budgets outright that just lead to nothing of use. We are going to cut these down, reform and then reimburse the people with the money the government essentially stole from them. This'll cut our demands and help our people, but the fat cats may not like these harsh actions.

focuses.name: States Rights Commission
focuses.description: The old order which struck down our constitution has struck further into the hearts of our very nation. Thousands suffer daily due to blanket governmental decisions made by the federal body of government. It's an ordeal, no more. An independent commission will be used to give back to the people and their states what once was theirs to begin with.

focuses.name: 2nd Amendment, 1st Priority
focuses.description: Traitors to the nation. A long festering group of people have got it in the public's mind that guns kill people. The reality is that people kill people using said weapons. We must standardize the responsible way to exercise to the fullest extent the constitutional right to bear arms against any kind of invader. Be they domestic or foreign.

focuses.name: Constitutional Welfare
focuses.description: The damage to the nation is on a psychological level. In order to fix this we must be subtle but firm in our messaging. Service to the constitution and the nation shall make sure they service you. Welfare is for the citizens of our nation, but those who defend her values must be prioritized above all. A strong symbol for those who try to destroy those values.

focuses.name: Constitutional Healthcare
focuses.description: The citizens of this fair nation must be cared for in their time of need. Reforms are taking place in order to rid of the fallacies of the previous republican and democratic influences. States can have their local healthcare, but the federal government can also implore its own healthcare to those citizens which defend and uphold her constitutional values.

focuses.name: Constitutional Securities
focuses.description: The national infrastructure and development to connect and grow these geographically diverse lands is an important job. The federal government must seek out volunteers to protect important infrastructure like electrical stations, ports and so forth. With the right incentives and training we can make this nation a safe nation for the ideal life of those who wish to live, build and prosper.

focuses.name: A Living Document For A Living Nation
focuses.description: The nation, her founding document and the citizens of this republic have been shown the way. The light is bright for those who delight in the continuation of the great American experiment.

focuses.name: The Rhino Charges Forward
focuses.description: With the living document reinforced it has since breathed the fresh air of our ideals into reality. This new victory will see the continued success of our dear nations' values soar to new levels. The Rhino charges on, traitors fear and shall be gone.

focuses.name: The Founders Act
focuses.description: The founders would not have wanted the past to stifle the future. Therefore we seek the wisdom of these forward thinkers of their time and we shall more than apply that to now. Increased budgeting to states who cannot afford their education system uniformity will be made. The states create the floor, we help them to reach up to and break through the ceiling.

focuses.name: The Modern Age Act
focuses.description: For all men are created equal. This quotation is what America was founded on. Tolerance is her beacon, her drive and her purpose. Legalization and enforcement of secular understandings of human decency and of same sex couples, relationships and so forth shall never be punishable by law. The constitution does not state what some men can and cant do, it states that all men can do. The people of this nation should and will be able to do right by this singular principle of our glorious modern age we live in.

focuses.name: Scholars Interpretation Act
focuses.description: The SIA is a legislation which mandates legally the methodology when interpreting the constitution in relation to modern problems. The language was written for the time it was in. As such when that language changes we must look back to the time and understand what that change was and the reality in which it applies towards. Remember, all men...are created equal. Not all males...Think about it scholar.

focuses.name: The Uniform Institutions Act
focuses.description: Our federal government has made a mess of foreign policy to the point it has distracted from domestic policy. We shall fix this by implementing legislation on the regulation and uniformity of government institutions both domestic and abroad. With these cuts in excesses and investments in nations they essentially wanted control of we can give back to the people of our nation with a tax cut in the coming budget report.

focuses.name: Worthy Trade Deals
focuses.description: We are a nation of producers and these last decades have seen us only become consumers. We shall find that balance using trade deals to reduce our exports which help domestic production and consumption to lead a new rise in our industry.

focuses.name: The Historical Rationalism Act
focuses.description: Modern culturalism has infected the historical understandings of how we perceive and understand said history. Question everything and look to the time period of comprehension. Legislation shall be made to standardize and enforce a uniformity of understanding of history. We must question the sources, we must compare them and we must come to a neutral understanding. Nothing is ever as simple as we want it to be, therefore we must rationalize it into simplicity in comprehension. To our nation, to the history we have made and the reality it is. Our nation will build back better and develop our nation with this new insight. History teaches more than names, dates and places.

focuses.name: The Backyard Act
focuses.description: Our backyard is filthy and destroyed. Reforms in federal law enforcement agencies to focus on cartel infiltrations, gun runners and trafficking of any kind will be the backbone. Our citizens must be safe and our backyard must be cleaned up and cared for.

focuses.name: Tightening The National Belt
focuses.description: The budget is inflated due to the struggle we face in transitioning more responsibility to the states. Therefore we look to slice off pieces from programs and agencies which may not always use the extra cash. While it may stunt what we want, in the long run it will help up regardless.

focuses.name: One Nation, Under God
focuses.description: We are a secular nation, but everyone believes in a god of sorts. With this uniting principle that we are the defenders of faith itself regardless of the faith itself. We will rally our people and charge forth to defend our great peoples, our great nation and our great faiths.

focuses.name: A Constitutional Republic
focuses.description: A Democracy is the rule of the masses, rule of the mob. A Republic is the rule of law. We are a Constitutional Republic, a nation where our constitution is the supreme law of the land. Though we have subverters all around us, we can nevertheless agree on the vast achievements we have strode to create in these days following the fall of the Duopoly. The American Experiment lives on, in all of us.

focuses.name: Limited Government and Constitutional Adherence
focuses.description: We support upholding the U.S. Constitution strictly and encouraging little government involvement in people's daily lives.

focuses.name: Fiscal Responsibility and Balanced Budgets
focuses.description: To achieve a balanced budget and avoid an excessive amount of national debt, we place a high priority on sensible fiscal policies, which include decreasing government spending.

focuses.name: Individual Rights and Liberties
focuses.description: defending the individual liberties and rights guaranteed by the Constitution, such as the freedom of expression, the practice of religion, and the right to keep and bear arms.

focuses.name: States' Rights and Federalism
focuses.description: Upholding the Tenth Amendment's concept of federalism, which gives states significant power to rule inside their own borders.

focuses.name: Free Market Economics
focuses.description: In order to promote economic growth and prosperity, policies that support free enterprise, competition, and minimal government regulation should be promoted.

focuses.name: Defending Our Nation, Not Others
focuses.description: Promoting a strong national defense while being wary of offensive military operations and concentrating on a non-interventionist approach will allow us to better balance the homefront and the world around us.

focuses.name: Originalist Judiciary Appointments
focuses.description: Promoting a selection of judges who apply the Constitution's original meaning will strengthen internal cohesion and governmental efficiency. As opposed to the modern interpretations which have led us so far astray.

focuses.name: Constitutional Immigration Systems
focuses.description: We are promoting a balanced approach to immigration that includes both border security and the implementation of fair and just immigration laws. As described in the constitution.

focuses.name: The Nationalist Front Party..Wins?
focuses.description: The NFP is a coalition movement within the general right wing political sphere. Though the party has won the election many people are not sure the direction or the victory itself will last. For now the nation seems united in anti-socialist politics and the increasing immigration waves, but will these points hold the party together.

focuses.name: American Trade Act
focuses.description: We trade our souls away if they weren't attached to our bodies. The ATA will put an end to the destructive selling out we do on a national level, giving more goods for domestic consumption and manufacturing to have available to them.

focuses.name: American Jobs Act
focuses.description: The AJA is legislation designed to increase American production. From raw materials through finished products we will restore the industrial might this nation was once known for.

focuses.name: Foreign Economic Subversion Act
focuses.description: The FES Act is a stance against the practice of Neo-Imperialism, tactics which have been used to keep in check the development and exploitation of the less developed nations of the world for decades now. We shall not fall to such simple tricks and as such will begin nationalizing some industries and creating an outline and strict guidelines to operation of foreign subverters in our nation.

focuses.name: Immigration Regulations Act
focuses.description: The near open border policy of previous administrations is disgusting. We will make a comprehensive reform to the border handling methods, organization of guard posts and the immigration process. Many may push back in the stricter direction we are taking this, but if we can improve domestic standards we won't need foreign imports.

focuses.name: The American Care Act
focuses.description: Our people have no support, they work so much and in turn never do their duty to the species. The family as a whole has fallen apart due to a number of things, but we must at least build a proper care net for new families of this great nation.

focuses.name: Monroe Modernization Act
focuses.description: The hegemonic order we established with the Monroe Doctrine has been cast aside by modern globalization efforts. While we can't enforce the stoppage of such trade we can however be a bit more enticing towards a more hemispheric control and command.

focuses.name: The Public Protections Act
focuses.description: Scum ravages the streets of our nation and our people are hard pressed to be able to do their jobs and raise their families. With crime at the forefront of this bill we will change the matrix of aggression our boys in blue can do for you.

focuses.name: Landlords Association Act
focuses.description: The landlords of the nation have caused artificial shortages, while not a critical factor it is nevertheless a key factor. Landlords now must register with the Landlords Association Board or LAB. A federal standard of quality control will be assessed to bring the citizens a fair and better standard of living.

focuses.name: United Peoples Act
focuses.description: The UPA will create a federal holiday celebrating the people of this nation. Their struggles, their strengths and their achievements which have molded and saved this nation from its enemies both foreign and domestic.

focuses.name: The Anti-Subversives Act
focuses.description: The Communists have tainted our nation for too long. We will begin outlawing protests organized by these rabble-rousers and cracking down federally on the subversion and near treason some of these groups force onto the general public.

focuses.name: American Jobs For American People Act
focuses.description: The AJAP Act is legislation which will help solidify our understanding of the economy and the American citizen. Too many times are perfectly qualified or new workforce candidates passed over cause of a cheaper alternative cause Paco, Tojo or whoever comes across our border. Well no more, American jobs are for American citizens through and through.

focuses.name: Family Care Package Act
focuses.description: We must care for our nations' families, how else are we to care for our people if we cant even see them help their own.

focuses.name: Skyline to Space Bound Act
focuses.description: The next generation must be able to breach the skyline. Investments in new training programs, weapons testing, and aircraft shall be ensured to keep the curve of our defense even as we breach the skyline itself.

focuses.name: Water Defense Act
focuses.description: The nation is surrounded by water, our sphere of influence is literally encompassed by water. The navy must be a large priority to ensure the right of way which our peacekeepers in this era of peace and prosperity of our world.

focuses.name: National Recruitment Act
focuses.description: The young men and women of our nation are left to rot in the septic tank of society. Encouraging recruitment while increasing standards will encourage duty bound folks and create an image of the military that sets it above our foes both foreign and domestic.

focuses.name: Old Order, New Ideals Education Act
focuses.description: While the old absolutists of their day were horrid and ignorant to the realities of their surroundings, many still believe that a constitutional monarchy of sorts would be arguably better than the instability of the age. To capitalize on this small but somehow slowly growing minority we must reform the education system to include these past mistakes and how we can learn from them.

focuses.name: Administrational Reforms
focuses.description: The administration of the nation is a transparent entity which has created distrust and deceit throughout the nation. We will use this to our advantage to oust rivals and slowly change the status quo to be able to put the ball in our court.

focuses.name: An American Dynasty
focuses.description: The movement grows for the establishment of limit monarchal organization and reform in the government. With this we must solidify by rallying behind a common factor which is that an American dynasty is an elected dynasty. The President shall be the King and the elections will be by the people and for the people.

focuses.name: Concessions To The Naturalists
focuses.description: The naturalists are a very vocal and growing minority. The fact is we don't have the investments quite yet to change the impacts that the reliance of immigrants has had on the national population growth. Therefore we must make concessions related to immigration intake, it'll disrupt the growth aspect a bit but we can make it work.

focuses.name: Concessions To The Militarists
focuses.description: The Military Industrial Complex is a part of American culture, we can't destroy it as a fair amount of our base is within it. However with the right motivation we can certainly help one another out.

focuses.name: Concessions To The Reformists
focuses.description: The Reformists, a mix of monarchist and modern egalitarian conservatives have been a thorn in our side as these modernists seek to create the new sort of right wing as one built around only the national identity. We can't fully commit to such a thing as it would alienate the naturalists and militarists, but we can reform police work to give a better sense of equal national footing. Americans are Americans in the long run of it.

focuses.name: Right Wing Unity
focuses.description: Unity and national pride triumphs against all forms of subversion. With the quick thinking and strong leadership our coalition had held strong. Right Wing Unity prevails in this new world and as such we shall make the American Dream the American Future. God bless this nation, its land and her citizens... God Bless America.

focuses.name: National Sovereignty and Autonomy
focuses.description: We advocate for policies that prioritize the interests and independence of the United States in global affairs, emphasizing national sovereignty and self-determination.

focuses.name: Secure Borders and Controlled Immigration
focuses.description: We support stringent border control measures and responsible immigration policies to protect national security and regulate immigration for the benefit of the country.

focuses.name: Economic Patriotism and Domestic Industry
focuses.description: We promote policies that prioritize American industries, workers and businesses through trade policy, job creation initiatives and support for domestic manufacturing.

focuses.name: Cultural Unity and Integration
focuses.description: We will focus on supporting a shared sense of national identity and encouraging cultural assimilation while respecting diverse origins and traditions.

focuses.name: Strong Defense and National Security
focuses.description: Our priority is a well-financed and strong military to ensure the security and defense of the United States and its interests abroad.

focuses.name: Energy Independence, Sustainable Resources
focuses.description: Creating policies aimed at energy self-sufficiency through responsible resource management, renewable energy initiatives and reducing dependence on foreign sources.

focuses.name: American Infrastructure Renaissance
focuses.description: As the most developed and advanced country, we are prioritizing investment in and modernization of critical national infrastructure such as transport, energy and technology to create jobs and support economic growth.

focuses.name: Education for American Excellence
focuses.description: Our goal is to improve educational standards, job training and educational innovation to equip American students and workers with the skills they need to succeed.

focuses.name: Championing American Innovation
focuses.description: Investing OUR money in OUR research and development to maintain America's leadership in technology, innovation and scientific progress.

focuses.name: Health and Wellness for All Americans
focuses.description: Our healthcare system is controversial. We believe this must change to ensure the health and well-being of all Americans through policies that address public health challenges and promote access to high-quality health care.

focuses.name: Environmentalism Through Growth
focuses.description: We will ensure environmental protection through responsible resource management and innovations to support American industries and communities.

focuses.name: Support for Veterans and Military Families
focuses.description: We are responsible for ensuring veterans and their families receive the care, benefits and support they deserve in serving our nation.

focuses.name: Preservation of American Heritage
focuses.description: America will celebrate and protect our natural beauty, wildlife and landscapes for future generations to enjoy.

focuses.name: Community Empowerment
focuses.description: We are committed to policies that empower local communities and promote local decision-making to address their unique needs and challenges.

focuses.name: American Tradition
focuses.description: We celebrate and protect America's cultural heritage, history and traditions as a source of national pride and identity.

focuses.name: Public Safety
focuses.description: We will prioritize policies that ensure public safety, effective law enforcement and fair criminal justice practices.

focuses.name: International Engagement
focuses.description: Supporting foreign policy decisions that prioritize American interests in our hemisphere and values diplomatic, economic and security activities.

focuses.name: Military Seizes Power
focuses.description: In a well coordinated effort along with both military and civilian leaders, the hardliners of the NFP were rounded up and jailed on a various amount of charges ranging from subversion of the party to treason by act of national security risk. In the end many knew this would come, they just didn't expect it to be so quick. Nevertheless Washington is no longer the true capital of the US and now most decisions come from the Pentagon itself. However will the military apparatus lead the nation compared to the civilian leaders, many outside of the US fear this screaming eagle may become aggressive while others seek to create coridal ties to stem the eyes of the general staff. In the end, the world has seen a new era of global politics and not even god himself may know what lies ahead.

focuses.name: Economic Militarism
focuses.description: Our nation is strong, it has the abilities in both raw material and human resources to secure global peace and stability. But for too long the politicians squandered and wasted valuable resources across the board. As such we will begin to regear our economy to be prepared for any military conflict the enemies of our republic wish to bring forth.

focuses.name: Economic R&D
focuses.description: To continue our optimization efforts for our economy we need to establish an Economic R&D effort. As such we will do this to secure our nation's economic security.

focuses.name: National Wellness Programs
focuses.description: The NWPs are a series of ways to give back to those the give for the nation. If the citizens take care of the state and as such the state will do the same. Since we could be looking towards a war this sentiment weighs heavy on all.

focuses.name: Strategic Quotas
focuses.description: Our economic prowess will know no bounds. However in times of crisis and war, sacrifices are expected to be made and as such we will issue a rotating schedule of strategic quotas to get the population the idea and understanding of what could be needed of them in the future.

focuses.name: Integrated Corps Of Engineers
focuses.description: By utilizing the Corps of Engineers and other aspects of the military in public works projects and the like, we can create a new standard of development our citizens have yet to experience. Not only that, who wouldn't want to join the military knowing they don't have to go out and die in some far off land, now that's what you call free PR.

focuses.name: Investing In Naval Companies
focuses.description: Funding research initiatives within several naval companies will allow both our civilian and military industry to create new ships as well as find ways to quicken repair efforts. Remember, military innovations breed new civilian innovations and the same goes for the inverse.

focuses.name: Automations Act
focuses.description: To improve our potential economic output as well as grow our potential conscription pool, we must invest in automation where and when possible. It won't be a liked thing by the people, but it is a needed evil if we are to survive.

focuses.name: Mandatory Employment Administration
focuses.description: The MEA is a government administrative body to help get those without employment, well, employed. Taking inspiration from some New Deal era three letter agencies, the MEA is here to help all those who need a job.

focuses.name: Future Warfare Innovations Program
focuses.description: The FWIP is a R&D complex dedicated to innovations to make the fighting forces of tomorrow. Through tireless efforts we will ensure our armed services will be unmatched throughout the globe.

focuses.name: Army Armaments Improvements
focuses.description: Through development contracts we are able to improve the armaments our soldiers are equipped with. With this we hope to improve our army's overall capabilities in holding and taking the field of battle.

focuses.name: Mobile Observation Force
focuses.description: The MOF is a specialized force related to recon initiatives. This new force will be a highly mobile unit in charge with keeping tabs on enemy movements and ensuring our troops get as much warning to incoming attacks and general movements when and where possible.

focuses.name: Localized Logistics
focuses.description: Improved logistics in terms of smaller units and flexibility metrics will hopefully allow our army to be more coordinated as well as be more prepared for whatever the enemy may throw at us.

focuses.name: Naval Gunnery Advancements
focuses.description: Researching new gunnery training regiments as well as improving the standing munitions and weapons systems on our fleet is paramount to defending our coastal waters as well as taking the fight to the enemy if and when need be.

focuses.name: Propulsion Advancements
focuses.description: Improving the engines and propulsion systems on our naval vessels will allow our ships to reach each other faster than ever before. Not to mention the battlefield initiative this will bring in the coming wars.

focuses.name: Increased Pay Incentives
focuses.description: Our naval personnel are mostly sitting ducks with little chance to properly escape from an enemy force. These hardships means we should properly compensate them. With this compensation we will also increase naval drills in combat and disengagement of enemy forces to ensure the survival and effectiveness of every ship and personnel on those ships.

focuses.name: Aircraft Improvements
focuses.description: Investing in making better more agile aircraft means we also need to invest in our personnel to be able to properly handle these war machines. As such we will do just such in order to make clear skies for our citizens.

focuses.name: Increasing Drill Intensity
focuses.description: Refining, intensifying and improving our aircraft drills to improve overall effectiveness will see results in mission effectiveness as well as combat capabilities.

focuses.name: Weapon Systems Innovations
focuses.description: R&D investments into improving weapon systems on our aircraft will lead to more effective combat scenarios which will hopefully result in a net positive gain in future conflicts where possible.

focuses.name: Pre-Emptive Mobilization
focuses.description: The time has come, we must begin to mobilize the nation to ensure our future is a secured certainty.

focuses.name: Securing Southern Interests
focuses.description: The rampant gang violence and a somewhat ineffective federal government for the modern age, Mexico is the key to securing continental dominance and security for the hemisphere.

focuses.name: Operation Clean Streets
focuses.description: Now that we've secured our southern territories, we must embark on a strict clean up operation to rid of the area of massive gang cliques as well as begin to integrate the territories.

focuses.name: Securing Atlantic Interests
focuses.description: By securing the major island nations of Cuba, Jamaica and Hispaniola, we set a precedent of hemispheric security unlike any other.

focuses.name: Operation Paradise
focuses.description: Operation Paradise is networking the new territories for integration and immediate utilization of military infrastructure.

focuses.name: Policing & Cultural Programs
focuses.description: Our new gains will always be met by those who wish to undermine our nation and its citizens. As such we need to institute cultural programs to promote unity and uniformity as we are human first and not simply, american, cuban and so forth. As a side note, increasing and integrating police as well as military police forces can also help to quell excessive agitation.

focuses.name: A True Leader Of The Western World
focuses.description: To secure our hemisphere we need to also secure the true leadership of the western world. Remember that any attack on a NATO member will be a declaration on the whole alliance. So this strike will determine our future. God help us all.

focuses.name: Operation Great North
focuses.description: With the dust settled and our victory secured, we can now begin to integrate and secure our continental dominance as well as hemispheric hegemony.

focuses.name: Operation Atlantic Viking
focuses.description: Securing the near artic lands of Greenland and Iceland as well as the Atlantic barrier island of the Faroe Islands will secure our Atlantic connections and allow us to have a more direct logistics network between the new and old worlds.

focuses.name: Operation Atlantic Wall
focuses.description: With our position as leader of the western world assured, we must also ensure that said position is stable and able to be held. As such we will acquire all atlantic territories and use it to help control logistics, markets and those further in the continent. The future is now and the future is bright.
