focuses.name: Humanity Marches Onwards
focuses.description: Our mark on the globe is secured, our populations at the very least are content. While the way is not over, we are at a significant point for which we can begin to roll back the hyper militarization and place more of an economic development phase. This is the way and it is this way for which we will reach the stars in the near future. United we stand, divided we all fell.

focuses.name: American Naturalist Seize Power
focuses.description: With the moderates fleeing the nation, the people taking their own initiative in handling the Un-Americans and the nation seeming to become chaotic the American Naturalists Party seizes the reins of power over the NFP. Now the nation is ruled by the iron will of those who hear the people's cries of needing security. They will lead America into a new age of modernity through tradition, a new age of prosperity through national spirit and will, as well as a new age of security through heavy handed action. The people spoke and those with the aspirations took the mantle of leadership and will lead this new American Age. For the call is now, "America For Americans".

focuses.name: Closed Border
focuses.description: To secure our nation and its cultural integrity, we must shut down the border. From there we can choose how to reform the immigration policy so we can begin accepting the correct peoples who can contribute to our society.

focuses.name: Family Planning Incentives
focuses.description: If we are to really fix our nation, to present a new and pure way forward. We must first look after our own first and foremost. The birthrate decline is a global issue that happens the more developed a nation becomes. However rather than just "return to monkey", like some seem to feel we must do, we instead create programs to help and assist families and expecting parents. This limits the burden on the new families as well as secures the future of new generations not having to go through mired hardships due to financial influences.

focuses.name: Encouraging Productivity Quotas
focuses.description: Our citizens deserve the best products and it is this that we will provide. Fine tooling statistical consumption of know goods and services will allow us to set up quotas in which these luxuries and or common day items will go down in price. This will improve quality of life for all citizens.

focuses.name: Federally Sponsored Emigration Programs
focuses.description: Our nation has leeches and parasites which suck off the generous teat of our taxpayers and the benevolent federal programs to look after active members of our society. So we must give them an offer they can't refuse. Targeting a mix of countries with similar quality of life as well as just good exchange rates where the USD is more valued than the country the targets will move to, we set forth the ability to peacefully rid our nation from the continued drain on our resources that some of these folks have become.

focuses.name: Strategic Automation Programs
focuses.description: The SAPs act is a targeted automation initiative to increase production of needed goods to allow for a better trend for developing our nation and our citizens quality of life.

focuses.name: Forging New Innovations
focuses.description: The institute of Innovations is the R&D complex of tomorrow. Setting forth a new standard of researching which will allow us to stay ahead against the competition.

focuses.name: The Development Corps
focuses.description: The establishment of the Development Corps is a federal initiative to conscript convicts as well as volunteers and the unemployed to do their part in bettering our society. Convicts can look to slowly work off their sentence through good behavior during their time in the Corps and both volunteers and the unemployed can look to gain some extra or just initial income in their time of needs.

focuses.name: Developing Prison Workforces
focuses.description: The Department of labor will look to create the Prison Labor Administration or PLA. The PLA will be tasked by creating rehabilitation programs through dedicated job sites. Things like primary and select secondary industries may see workforce substitutions which overall will benefit the wider society.

focuses.name: Gearing The Nation For Survival
focuses.description: Our nation is pure, our citizens are of strong will and mind, we must show them our enemies and inform them of the survival we are facing to preserve our very way of life. The so called "western world" only seeks to limit our nation and the rightful place we should've had centuries ago. A new destiny will be manifested and no one will stop us.

focuses.name: Retooling Officer Corps Requirements
focuses.description: By changing the requirements for enrollment as well as advancement opportunities to be more influenced around ideological motivations, we set a standard of uniformity and unity among the command structure. This will hopefully in both the field and HQ command elements allow for a more enriched vigor in achieving objectives.

focuses.name: Ideological Motivation Drills
focuses.description: By instilling values of what each soldier is fighting for and who the enemies are to be, we can create a will power in our soldiers that most other countries simply can not recreate. We are stronger cause we choose to be. Unity is Strength.

focuses.name: Improved Logistical Organizations
focuses.description: Our country is massive and regardless if we were to go north or south, the territories are vast and not suitable for mass transportation. We must therefore reorganize and improve how our logistics operate to ensure our soldiers get all the needed materials to wage war anywhere any time.

focuses.name: General Weapons Testing Complex
focuses.description: The GWTC is a dedicated testing facility to improve overall military weapon systems....that's it, nothing more.

focuses.name: Phase Two Weapons Testing
focuses.description: Now this is what you call more bang for your buck.

focuses.name: Engineering Better Engines
focuses.description: Improving engines of all sizes means we can have better mobility to exploit gaps in the enemy's line. We can make more agile and capable aircraft to patrol and guard our very skies. Not to mention we can improve ship maneuverability and patrol rates to make sure the enemy is always on their toes.

focuses.name: Paying The Dues Our Soldiers Deserve
focuses.description: Our soldiers, both volunteers and conscripts lay down their lives for this nation and as such must be treated as heroes. Their pay must reflect the work they do as to give the impression of what these soldiers do is truly recognized.

focuses.name: Militarized Economy
focuses.description: The population is ready and we are preparing the final acts of preparation. Soon a new age will be upon us and our global security for the western hemisphere will be assured.

focuses.name: Operation Pig Bay Two
focuses.description: Cuba has eluded us since the botched CIA operation known as the Bay of Pigs. Well no more, we're calling the shots officially and so now we're ready for round two. This time we'll be victorious.

focuses.name: Operation Hispaniola
focuses.description: To secure our foothold into the Gulf as well as surrounding nations, we must take out the next largest island which is that of Hispaniola. This contains the stable and unstable nations of The Dominican Republic and Haiti. Should be over by lunch time.

focuses.name: Operation Makin Me Happy
focuses.description: To further our reach we must secure the island chain that is the Bahamas as well as the island nation of Jamaica. This gives us a barrier around our inital gains as well as sets the stage for further incursions.

focuses.name: Operation Clean Sweep
focuses.description: Like a chain of dominos we shall make each one of these island nations fall.

focuses.name: Extra Territorial Corps
focuses.description: The creation of the ETC is to create a dedicated reserve force to allow for the clear and through management of our new territories.

focuses.name: Operation Cartel
focuses.description: Now that we've secured the Gulf and Caribbean region, we now can full focus on our hemispheric advance. From the border we shall strike the fragile Mexican state and make it into a land of law and order once more.

focuses.name: Operation Fruit Master
focuses.description: American interests have never left the central american nations. For corporate or national reasons the US has always been meddling in the affairs of these nations. Well now comes the time for direct rule and control as these floundering nations seem to not hold their own in any real regard.

focuses.name: Operation Gran Colombia
focuses.description: The final steps are upon us as we now take the fight to the southern half of OUR hemisphere. Using Trinidad & Tobago as a spring board, we can then invade the smaller nations of Guyana and Suriname. This spring board will allow us to push westward and sweep the upper half of South America.

focuses.name: Operation Amazon
focuses.description: The "final boss" of the South American continent, Brazil will be the biggest challenge towards us as the logistics of traversing such a naturally hostile land is bound to cause immediate impacts to troop quality and logistical needs. Nevertheless we will forge forward and unite the hemisphere.

focuses.name: Operation La Plata
focuses.description: The second to final step. The La Plata region and surroundings will soon be under the fold.

focuses.name: Proclaiming The Union
focuses.description: Almost every last bit of land in the Americas is now ours. Unity is finally here, however, the job is not done. We must reorganize and strengthen ourselves internally and prepare for the final act. The Great Northern Expedition.

focuses.name: The Final Chapter
focuses.description: The Union is declared, our enemies on our side of the globe are few. Now we must finish the job and take the fight to the old world if we have to.

focuses.name: The American Dynasty Rises
focuses.description: Through leaps and bounds the MMM has secured power over the more closeted and protectionist NFP. The coalition in many eyes was doomed to fail, but no one expected the Modern Monarchist to be so popular in of all nations America itself.

focuses.name: The Nobility Act
focuses.description: The creation of a modern nobility is one that needs careful thinking. As such a modern noble can come from any piece of cloth of society. However each piece will have their own requirements as to be fair to each strata. For example, business tycoons must show proof of investment of a specified amount, to be determined, of growth in the national economy. They must also donate a specified amount to recognized charity organizations like the Red Cross for example. Ect, ect, ect. This is but a sample of the new nobility act and the doors that it'll open for social advancement as well as personal goals to help in life.

focuses.name: Tied To Office Act
focuses.description: The "Tied To Office Act" is a legislation that formalizes the numeric sequence to "titles". Rather than the foolish metric of tying the title to blood, it will instead be tied to the respective office, or in the case of the nobility act, be tied to the requirements met to get a noble title license.

focuses.name: Workforce Welfare Act
focuses.description: The WWA is legislation used to reform and refine the welfare state portion around the workforce compensation in relation to disability and time off for maternity and other related incapacitation ailments.

focuses.name: Education Investments Act
focuses.description: Comprehensive investments into our education system will allow for nationwide improvements to our economy and the jobs in which both our citizens can take part in as well as create themselves.

focuses.name: Declaring The Empire
focuses.description: It is on this day that we make the ultimate reform. From a Constitutional Republic to a Constitutional Republic with an Elective Monarchy. It is this day forward that we are known as, "The Holy American Empire".

focuses.name: Re-Adjusting Foreign Trade Policies
focuses.description: By using our own natural abundance we can renegotiate trade plans between nations that look to force us into tapping our own reserves. If we can save those reseves for as reasonably long as possible this gives us a long term investment in future trade deals and global economic influences.

focuses.name: Creating The Penal Labour Corps
focuses.description: By creating rehabilitation programs around labour projects, we can improve public infrastructure or advance the productivity of primary industries. We therefore can benefit our citizens' overall quality of life by bringing more goods back to domestic production.

focuses.name: Creating More Domestic Supply Chains
focuses.description: By focusing on diversifying the local economic makeup through creating new domestic supply chains allows our nation to be more self reliant as well as break into markets we once thought were dominated by only a select set of nations.

focuses.name: Expanding Military Education Programs
focuses.description: By expanding and potentially mandating the leadership programs known as the Junior Reserve Officer Training Corps or JROTC for short, we open the volunteering rate to be expanded through passive exposure to the military. As a bonus we can also teach future generation leadership skills which are just as viable in the civilian workforce as they would be in the military.

focuses.name: Army Investments
focuses.description: By increasing funding and directing it towards improvements related to the average infantry person, we can begin to better the combat capabilities for which each soldier will be, well, capable of.

focuses.name: Baby Stepping Mandatory Service
focuses.description: The country has had a full volunteer force for pretty much its entire existence. However with modern wars and enemies being so muddled and unknown it's best to be proactive rather than reactive. Therefore legislation will be enacted to institute a four month mandatory service period to at least get the population acquainted with the very basics of soldiering.

focuses.name: Naval Investments
focuses.description: Improving our naval prowess and abilities will allow us to pre-emptively strike any enemy invasion force be they on this side of the world or not.

focuses.name: Improving Shipping Industries
focuses.description: By investing and setting up better contract deals we hope to improve our nation's shipping and general naval industries. This will help us in both the civilian and military realms as we strive to navigate the modern age of geo-political entanglements.

focuses.name: Dedicated Aeronautical Research Institute
focuses.description: The ARI is a R&D complex dedicated to improving and developing our air force to be more effective then ever before.

focuses.name: Hemispheric Influence
focuses.description: Through soft power and subtle influences, we can look to control the hemisphere we already have a majority influence in, in a more direct manner.

focuses.name: The Northern Kingdom Agreement
focuses.description: The "empire of the north" also known as the vast lands of Canada, should be more in line with the western hemisphere's needs. As such we must try to pressure and help them to understand that the British/English are long gone from the meaningful presence they once had. However, we can let them be a part of a new age of unity, trade and innovation. We must convince them, we have to convince them.

focuses.name: The Southern Kingdom Agreement
focuses.description: The disposition of Mexico has never really been in the positive per se. We can use this to assure public order and stability to their nation as well as issue trade initiatives to show we are serious in helping them for the betterment of everyone. Let's just hope they understand is all.

focuses.name: The Federation Proposal
focuses.description: Despite the historical animosity, we can do our best to try and convince Cuba that we mean well and want a more pro-western hemisphere agenda. What benefits them will benefit the hemisphere at large. We can also sweeten the deal by giving them the green light on consolidating the Caribbean. Let's just hope it's sweet enough for them.

focuses.name: The United Principalities Offer
focuses.description: By spearheading talks with Panama, a nation we've had a relatively positive history with generally speaking. We can create a federation or union of states in Central America which will be led by them and helped in retaining order by us.

focuses.name: Gran Colombian Kingdom
focuses.description: To begin the Southern continental unity effort, well approach Colombia and work with them to re-establish the Kingdom of Gran Colombia. Old glories are always a nice offer for mutual benefit.

focuses.name: Brazil Comes To You
focuses.description: Everyone says Brazil is a bad place, there is even a joke called "you are going to Brazil". Well we want Brazil to come to them. We'll offer Brazil the ability to consolidate the southern half of the continent and we'll protect their interests and lead the way in a common hemispheric union.

focuses.name: Operation Screaming Eagle
focuses.description: For too long the globe has been messing within our hemisphere and agitating as well as diluting our efforts to create a more peaceable state of affairs. Now of course we have made mistakes in the past, but no more. We will take more drastic and direct actions to assure the path and destiny we will create. The new world will be renewed once more.

focuses.name: Operation Initial Gains
focuses.description: We've had time to build our forces and prepare our allies, now it is time for us to stretch our wings and consolidate the continents.

focuses.name: Economic Investments
focuses.description: Today we will spearhead the new Western Hemispheric Economic Program. We will facilitate and encourage the development of our new and closest allies and subject, so we can all prosper together.

focuses.name: Public Unity Programs
focuses.description: The PUP is a dedicated mutual aid program to encourage public unity within the new nations as well as promoting the new Hemispheric "New World" identity. This shared value of being a part of the new union will propel our development and understanding of one another as well as set forth a new age to go beyond the planet. For if we all are working together, what is there to truly focus on but the great beyond.

focuses.name: Operation Midtown Madness
focuses.description: The next phase in consolidation is upon us. Now while Cuba and Panama get multiple nations to war with, the terrain is significantly rougher for Colombia and Brazil. As such we will limit their casualties by better piece mealing their enemies.

focuses.name: Operation New World
focuses.description: The final phase of consolidation is upon us. Now it is time for our trusted allies and subjects to consolidate the rest of the new world so we may pave the way for a new and united future.

focuses.name: Continued Economic Ties
focuses.description: To further our economic cooperation and ties, we'll begin the New World Economic Exchange or NWEE. This program will better development efforts and continue to strive in the creation of the very bedrock that is the New Worlder Identity.

focuses.name: A New World Mineral Order
focuses.description: To signify our commitment to our allies and subjects we will endure a massive mineral investment profile across the whole hemisphere. It'll be pretty costly, but it is certainly worth it.

focuses.name: The Red Junta Seizes Power
focuses.description: Chaos in the capital as the Commissariat Corps of the military seized power in a mostly bloodless coup against what they called the "Soft Spot of Disunity", that prevented real Socialism to take hold of the nation. In an almost oxymoronic way the CC leadership has led the charge with a two pronged Unity Plan. Using military service and a mixed economic model favoring a more Socialist and or Social Democratic approach to the economy, the CC leadership will use these two pillars to create a united society, a united goal and a united identity to spearhead the future of these United States.

focuses.name: The Commissariat Declaration
focuses.description: We the people's military have taken control and wish to better and secure the workers lives. Therefore to understand this commitment to its fullest we will become the United Commissariats of America. A united people's military force looking out for the welfare and safety of its citizens.

focuses.name: Service Welfare Programs
focuses.description: To ensure personnel numbers stay within reasonable levels, we will begin to expand certain incentives that the military offers. Overall we don't expect a huge change, but all and all it should encourage recruitment while also giving more back to those that return to the civilian workforce.

focuses.name: Public Service Corps
focuses.description: The PSC is a sort of labour corps and or joint civilian and military engineering corps. The idea is to help development projects or upkeep on infrastructure.

focuses.name: Improved Service Health Programs
focuses.description: Investing in our healthcare programs around service members and former services members will hopefully increase recruiting numbers by incentivizing care both in and once you're out of the military.

focuses.name: Industrious Innovators Act
focuses.description: The IIA is a legislation and funding bill to promote economic innovations and ways to improve our economic output.

focuses.name: Industrial Expansion Fund
focuses.description: The IEF is a dedicated fund to create new economic development projects and improve not only the available jobs, but to also improve our economic makeup.

focuses.name: Infrastructure Improvement Fund
focuses.description: By better dedicating funds to developing infrastructure, we'll be able to overall improve our general economic output as supply chains have better and smoother ways of interconnecting with one another.

focuses.name: Strategic Resource Development Act
focuses.description: The SRDA is a dedicated funding and de-regulation effort to encourage and almost mandate the improvement of mineral extraction in the eastern half of the US. Specifically along the median states between what is considered "north" and "south" states.

focuses.name: Western Development Act
focuses.description: The WDA is a continuation of the SRDA in that it continues the western trend of strategic development continuing along the median states like Colorado, Utah, etc.

focuses.name: Rotating Training Programs
focuses.description: By setting up a rotating training system, we can improve the overall effectiveness of our troops. The RTP is focused on diversifying the terrain trainings our troops will be exposed to. In short one day and or some days they could be training in a marshland, then next it could be a desert.

focuses.name: Officer Refinement Program
focuses.description: By tirelessly working on refining and bettering our leadership, we can ensure the command and control element of our armed forces is as efficient as possible. This should benefit all branches where possible in terms of split second decision making as well as risk assessment and management within the field of battle.

focuses.name: Army Advancement Program
focuses.description: The AAP is a comprehensive investment into the general improvement of our army service branch. Weapons systems, equipment and soldiers are all but pieces in the wider puzzle for which we wish to complete.

focuses.name: Increased Training Programs
focuses.description: Increasing and keeping on top of our naval training programs, in terms of combat and non-combat scenarios gets soldiers better acquainted with the vessels they are assigned to. Consequently it make care and combat assessment of each vessel's crew allows our naval personnel to better themselves to the best of our ability to provide them the tools to do so.

focuses.name: Naval Propulsion Program
focuses.description: The NPP is a dedicated research program to improve the engines and propulsion systems of our naval vessels to give them a combat edge in maneuverability.

focuses.name: Naval Gun Research Initiative
focuses.description: Our naval personnel are only a piece of the power puzzle. We must improve our naval weapon systems if we are to genuinely defend ourselves, let alone defeat an enemy force.

focuses.name: Improved Armaments
focuses.description: By upgrading and advancing our aircraft weapon systems we can improve our overall effectiveness in combat scenarios.

focuses.name: Bettering Aircraft Models
focuses.description: Upgrading our existing aircraft models allows us to ensure more nimble aerial maneuvers to effectively secure an air zone from the enemy force.

focuses.name: Further Air Force Investments
focuses.description: By increasing our general investments towards our air force service branch, we set a new standard of improvement and advancement that the force can potentially come across the longer time and continual investment continues.

focuses.name: Department Of War Planning
focuses.description: Now that we've sufficiently expanded our economic and military prowess, we can attend to the ideas of spreading the revolution to those most in need.

focuses.name: War Plan Maple Leaf
focuses.description: As a part of the New World Department under the Department of War Planning. The initial goal is to secure the far north making our strategic situation the most secure as possible.

focuses.name: War Plan Cartel Cleanup
focuses.description: Continuing to secure our strategic position, the overtly destabilized position of our southern neighbor is a great concern for our national security. Nevermind the implications of a foreign enemy using Mexico as a stepping stone, the cartels and almost tribal like nature of a large swath of Mexican territory is cause enough to settle things once and for all.

focuses.name: War Plan Havana
focuses.description: The Cuban island is the largest island of Caribbean region which occupies a fairly strategic position. Not only is it the gateway into the Gulf of Mexico, but it is also a barrier to the wider Atlantic ocean. As such we must secure this for the ultimate port and naval network, which will secure trade and western hemispheric peace as we know it.

focuses.name: War Plan Homeward Bound
focuses.description: We begin the next chapter of our great advance. By returning to the old world and finishing the job our predecessors could not accomplish and spread the values of economic socialism to the masses of Europe.

focuses.name: War Plan Round Three
focuses.description: Two world wars and yet they still haven't learned their lesson. Well on the plus side, it wasn't their fault this time, its just good business is all.

focuses.name: War Plan Black Back Hand
focuses.description: The Black hand was a secret society built on Serbian nationalism and anti-Austro-Hungarian fervor. Well where they started a world war, we will finish the balkan peace by settling the most aggressive member. After all, "where there is a serb, there is Serbia" seems like nothing but imperialism.

focuses.name: War Plan Outback
focuses.description: The Australian "continent", is but a stepping stone into securing pacific and far east stability. As such we must take the first step in doing so now, rather than later.

focuses.name: War Plan Java
focuses.description: Indonesia is the largest island chain based nation which practically creates a clear path from Australia towards China. We must secure this nation if we are to have a proper jumping off point for the final battle.

focuses.name: War Plan Great Leap Forward
focuses.description: The final boss, the "great china". Well it'll be great no more when we spread true economic socialism and not this pseudo cultist totalitarianism with Chinese characteristics. Mao took a great leap forward to advance the nation of China, well now it's time to take our great leap forward in securing world peace and the true future of socialist values.

focuses.name: Peace In Our Time
focuses.description: With the New World, Old World and the Far East now secure, with strategic areas and major threats now contained, we can establish the global commissariat corps to return these lands to more peaceful and reserved places of living. We will solidify the global peace accords and set a new way forward for our species.

focuses.name: The SWP Trotskyist Seize Power
focuses.description: With a cut throat coup the SWP has seized power from the Shepard's Party Coalition. This shocking turn of events has many concerned exactly what will happen next as many understand the Trotskyist views the SWP have and what Trotsky is known for in terms of his Socialism. For now people hold their breath and look on to see what could come from such a drastic change in events.

focuses.name: Re-Industrialization Priority
focuses.description: The nation has lost its industrial might, we will and must fix this to achieve our goals.

focuses.name: National Economic Revival Act
focuses.description: The NERA is legislation for an aggressive spending package to promote industrialization throughout the nation.

focuses.name: Securing Our Resources
focuses.description: By limiting trade to only the bare minimum, we can begin to create more fully developed domestic supply chains. As a consequence this also allows us to better invest in mining operations to increase overall yield.

focuses.name: National Armaments Expansion Act
focuses.description: The NAEA is a funding bill to expand our military industrial base. This core factor of our economic prowess will secure our future for which we are destined for.

focuses.name: National Naval Industrialization Act
focuses.description: The NNIA is a targeted funding bill to expand and improve our naval and shipping industrial base. We must secure trade and the waters in and around us.

focuses.name: The Scarlet Army
focuses.description: Our scarlet banners will fly high as our troops are drilled and training to be the up most aggression in tactical maneuvering where and when possible.

focuses.name: The Scarlet Navy
focuses.description: By improving training means and adapting the soldiers to understand the core of the cause they are fighting for, we will instill a sense of duty and fervor to fight where most nations fall flat on. Consequently, repurposing some of the naval budget into more of an R&D metric allows us to improve weapon systems for our vessels.

focuses.name: The Scarlet Air Force
focuses.description: By investing in R&D related to our aircraft and their weapon systems, we can improve the combat capabilities of our air force by focusing on aggressive tactical advantages.

focuses.name: National Mobilization
focuses.description: The nation has been refined, now we must prepare them for the Great Struggle.

focuses.name: The Commissar Corps
focuses.description: The creation of the CAC or Commissar Army Corps is a great way to motivate leadership and soldiers to stand and defend what their lives are made to protect. Their families, homes and values for which we strive to hold dear to each and everyone's heart.

focuses.name: The Permanent Revolution
focuses.description: The die have been cast and now we must usher in a new age of peace, through revolution we will secure the global position of the Socialist State and its peoples.

focuses.name: Marching South
focuses.description: Thus the dominos shall fall as we begin to liberate the New World and its desperate attempts at "Socialism", its imperialist autocrats and western mongrels for governments. We shall swiftly move down to the Panama Canal and be at the doorstep of the South American continent.

focuses.name: Workers Paradise
focuses.description: The failed Socialist State of Cuba is a stain on Socialism. The rest are a mix of British and French lapdogs and just exploiters. We'll use them to leap frog our way to slowly surround the southern continent from both land and sea.

focuses.name: New World Order
focuses.description: As we position ourselves at the gates of South America, we shall burst through these gates for which we have created and set forth to create a new order in the new world. Viva la Revolution!

focuses.name: The Eagle Descends Onto The Continent
focuses.description: The weakest and yet richest link to securing the permanent revolution. Africa is a vast and diverse land and as such we must establish a good sector of control if we are to continue and securing the Socialist World Revolution.

focuses.name: The Northern Cleanup
focuses.description: Securing the northern part of the continent gives us access to the Middle East and the Med for the eventual return to the Old World.

focuses.name: Operation Congo Cabal
focuses.description: Operation Congo Cabal is the liberation of the central African region from imperialist, capitalist and staunch anti-worker governmental control.

focuses.name: Operation Geographic Horn
focuses.description: The Horn of Africa, or simply East Africa will open up our influences into Asia and the Pacific from now both sides of the globe.

focuses.name: Operation Capetown
focuses.description: With the New World secured we now have the chance to secure two thirds the access to the southern pole. This securing will allow us to prevent foreign missions and give us more reach to do our own missions and likely explore for natural resources.

focuses.name: Operation Old World
focuses.description: Through securing the final bits of the New world, we also potentially bring in the Old world, therefore we must be proactive and establish a base from which the anglo-sphere of our heritage came from.

focuses.name: Operation Norse
focuses.description: From our foothold on the Celtic isles, we can continue our great northern expedition and liberate the Scandinavian nations.

focuses.name: Operation West Has Fallen
focuses.description: From our foothold on the islands we now can make a clear holding on the continent with the western most nations. Liberation of the old world will be swift and just.

focuses.name: Operation Black Sea
focuses.description: From the far north we shall descend down and create a wall of liberation which divides the perpetual autocracy of the Russian State and the rest of Europe for which we will liberate.

focuses.name: Operation Vistula
focuses.description: Today begins our march east as we begin to liberate the core of the Old World. From oligarchic "democracies" to Capitalist exploiters we shall liberate the peoples of the old world one by one.

focuses.name: Operation Cradle
focuses.description: The cradle of civilization and yet it is filled with some of the most destructive peoples and governments. Well no more, we shall liberate and bring true civilization to the workers of these lands and create a new future. A bright and scarlet future for all.

focuses.name: Operation Sarajevo
focuses.description: A world war was started in the Balkans, well now we intend to liberate and prevent further death and needless destruction.

focuses.name: Operation Caging The Bear
focuses.description: The Russian State, once the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, is a failed and stain on the Socialist name. We shall liberate her peoples, cage the autocrats and Capitalist exploiters and wipe the stain from the face of the planet.

focuses.name: Operation Himalayas
focuses.description: With the northern gateway secured we now can create the southern gateway. From here we will prepare for the final obstacle which prevents global liberation.

focuses.name: Operation Great Leap Forward
focuses.description: The final boss and its underlings and or side quests. The People's Republic of China is the biggest stain to come to the word Socialism after the failure that was the Soviet Union. We will and must liberate its lands and people if we are ever to properly finish any global revolution. After this "final boss", nothing stands in our way to true Communism and global peace and prosperity. From here, only the stars are the limit.

focuses.name: The Society Collectivizes Victory
focuses.description: In a surprising and near perplexing series of events the Anarchist Society has clawed their way through the leadership. Through struggles in selling their ideas as well as securing votes in leadership elections, enough members of the Anarchist Society has tipped the scales in their favor to secure majority leadership over the party. Now everyone looks on in almost awe to await what exactly an "Anarchist Government", will actually do.

focuses.name: Retooling Foreign Diplomacy
focuses.description: We need to cooperate with the wider world, but we know that we don't have to. As such to ensure simple and fair relations we will set our foreign policy as a cordial backstep. This means we'll engaging in talks and trade deals but all in all we'll be focusing more about our homeland and its people first.

focuses.name: Practical Education Act
focuses.description: The PEA is a collective legisilation understanding that education and the education system is there for one thing and one thing only. That is to teach and prepare our children to be a part of our society at large, in order to do that however we must overhaul the education system to focus and teach practical things and ensure their development. Basic language, reading and math skills will be the bedrock with students and parents having the choice of extending that education to more specialized fields of interest. This may create in the short term a partial brain drain, but with things like how to grow food and understanding the basics of being able to live and enjoy the simple things in life will result in at the very least an agricultural boom.

focuses.name: Life Is Hard
focuses.description: Our fundamental existence has caused an up roar in foreign governments around the world. Despite our recent acts to distance and looks more towards ourselves rather than the wider world, many foreign governments see our very existence as a threat to the supposed, "Natural Order". As such we must gear our nation and its people to defend their families and homes from anyone who wishes to make that fateful decision.

focuses.name: Hybrid Economics
focuses.description: With the changing winds we seek to encourage our citizenry to be prepared for survival. As such civilian manufacturies and other businesses must have a small percentage dedicated to military production. This way we bolster local defenses as well as ensure the ease of readiness if a foreign power should try to seize our land and people.

focuses.name: Decentralizing Corporate Entities
focuses.description: The soft power influences of modern economics is the scariest thing to a stable society. With foreign governments looking to use the soft power to bypass the use of force. This underhanded approach has resulted in us forcing our hand in the fact that we have been forced to speed up our decentralization of corporate type entities. In an extreme form of anti-monopoly enforcement, the cases brought forth will break up and even our the excessive market shares held by these titans of modern industries.

focuses.name: Reactive Autarky
focuses.description: Foreign trade is nearing non-existent levels due to the perceived threat we supposedly are to other national governments. With this in mind we must encourage local mining operations and do what we can to encourage the citizenry to understand the need to be self sufficient.

focuses.name: The Militarization Debate
focuses.description: The question of militarization is the biggest upset in our society. Many principled anarchist already are abhorrent to our mere existence cause of the paradox we preserve in the form of a "state". Nevertheless a good majority of the population is wondering and rightly worried about our preservation in living in such a free society. Therefore we must make a genuine discussion and come to a real agreement on what to do about the military force our nation will have.

focuses.name: The Survival Answer
focuses.description: The preservation of our nation is a must, we will ensure our defense is paramount and the top priority above all. As such R&D efforts, training and production will be geared to making sure we are the toughest nut to crack. There will be those who will cry for our supposed "abdication", for the throne of power we are supposedly creating. But the people will agree with us that defending our homes is the biggest principle to follow than some political arbitrary points.

focuses.name: The Volunteers Program
focuses.description: Fundamentally speaking we can't conscript, we'd lose our anarchist title by exerting that kind of force. But if we create incentive programs and adapt them we could bring in more volunteers passively. It'll cost us budgetary wise but it's worth the defense of the nation

focuses.name: Air Over Navy
focuses.description: We don't plan on traveling half way across the world any more for pointless wars and god knows what else the old order was doing. So with so much naval excess we can actually break down, scrap, repurpose and so much more into the air force. This saves our budget from increasing and ironically would decrease it in other regards as well. This will allow us to give even more back to the people which in turn would bolster our support.

focuses.name: Retooling Public Support
focuses.description: Speeches, signs and the realities is what we can do and what we will use to ensure the support of the people to shift their thinking to be more military oriented. This process will be slow and will likely hurt us cohesion wise. However we must let the people know of the real threat that some foreign governments perceive us as and the high possibility of a foreign attack on our collective.

focuses.name: Every Soldier A Path Finder
focuses.description: As we "recruit" more and more people we gain a wealth of passive experiences along the way. This experience is not that of any war college could teach, but rather the natural exposure that these folks have in terms of navigation of their local region. As such every soldier in our collective will be asked to hone in on these skills and teach and help those who are not that good or who are not familiar with the area in which they may operate. This will boost our cohesion as well as our ability to do defensive and if need be offensive actions to reclaim any lost territory the enemy force may covet.

focuses.name: The Free Citizen Army
focuses.description: We must seek out a collective identity for our military if we are to keep cohesion as well as support. Rally by the cause and the black flag, for the FCA will defend home and family from the enemies for which decide to step foot on our freedom.

focuses.name: American Culture Is Anarchism
focuses.description: The American way as some say is taking the definition of minarchism and then putting a weapon in every citizen's hands and saying, "You defend what's yours so the government nor other power cannot take it from you". This paramount individualism around the family or locality like a town is very in line with Anarchism and its collectivism through communes. All's we have to do is just change up some words and phrasing and every citizen will be honored to defend their home from invaders.

focuses.name: Butter, Bread, Ammo & Lead
focuses.description: Without food and army stops, without ammo and army stops functioning. Both sides of the economic spectrum are in fact literally the same coin. As such we will ensure the economy and the people are encouraged to defend as well as feed their own. Peace, Land and Bread will be ours.

focuses.name: The Village Model
focuses.description: Moving more in line economically towards Anarchism, we'll incentivize and allow communities and villages to be created where ever there is vacant land and the people who settle those lands will be able to create and provide what they want and what they can to defend their homes and new found lands.

focuses.name: The Militia System
focuses.description: The militia system is one seen used more frequently to a whole spectrum of results. Some militias self harden and become practically their own armies. Other militias practically are cannon fodder or even just target practice for the opposition, we will have results and we will preserve our ability to defend. The American culture of gun ownership, the free will to defend one's home and family will be used as a keystone of training and organization of military units for our Free Army. Orders will be explained to ensure that questions about them are minimal and arguments about the justness of the order is to as small of a degree as possible. Officer's will be voted for but the voting will be done according to the military aptitude of the person wanting to be voted in. This will dissuade the popularity contest that voting can divulge into and hopefully allow for our military to function as intended.

focuses.name: The Principle Answer
focuses.description: Our actions will shout out our intentions, we don't need militarization to keep ourselves under the thumb of power hungry folks to preserve our nation's safety. As such we will continue with our hybrid economics and look to more well roundedly respond to the needs of our people and whatever threats theoretically could arise.

focuses.name: The New Agrarianism
focuses.description: Food security, this is the reality which can make or break any of these governments. As such we should look to secure not only our own food, but the political sway that any excess food may have as a form of incentive to leave us be.

focuses.name: Mutual Agreements Diplomacy
focuses.description: With the massive shift in our economic power and our prioritization of decentralization, specialization and agrarianism, many in the world have understood that maybe, just maybe we can work with these "Anarchists". Therefore our diplomatic strategy moving forward is assuances related to mutual agreements. Trade deals and the like will be conducted in a manner which is seen as fair as possible for the mutual benefit for not only our society, but for the foreign societies which still are wary of our existence. It's not much, but its a continued step in the direction of self security.

focuses.name: De-Corporatization
focuses.description: In retooling our economy, we will focus heavily on decentralization through decorporatization. In doing this we give all power back to the individual, small communities and the back bone of any economy which is the mom & pop shop. We will make a new way forward together, for we are united in living, not divided by excesses of greed and "wealth".

focuses.name: The Societal Betterment Fund
focuses.description: Reorganization of the oppressive tax system is a chore in its own right. Everyone knows that expenditures for the well being of the society, through social, health and economic or infrastructure programs allows for the cohesive growth and sustainment of a modern society. However if we are to model something like that, we must approach it with a metric that makes sense within the confines of our society. If not we could expect civil disorder cause we are "stealing", the labor and wealth of the people and that would never do. As such we will organize the "Tax collection" like a donation drive. Explaining the programs we could fund and giving roadmaps and outlines of where specifically their money will go to in terms of the society, rather than just to the pockets of the few.

focuses.name: Defense Industry Council
focuses.description: A military force is not needed until it sudden is. Acts of aggression never are intended to make sense since the aggression is against our own species. However history of our species shows some limited form of a military is needed, with this in mind our focus is purely and ethusiastically defensive oriented. A defense industry council will be elected by voted local representatives to help establish and standardize the production of any kind of war related to ensure our safety from unwarranted aggression is a certainty.

focuses.name: The Society's Needs
focuses.description: Defunding the central authority is paramount and returning the wealth and labor of the citizens is the pillar of anarchism. We will work to give back truly to the society for the society itself knows what it needs.

focuses.name: The Minute Man Example
focuses.description: The minute men of old are what our society should've been. Regardless these stalwarts of individualism and courage to defend their families and homes is exactly what we will inspire and encourage our society to become. For we defend what is ours and we defend our right to self determination.

focuses.name: Gutting Government
focuses.description: To ensure a safe society, we must do what we can to gut the governmental bloat and excess. Things that would seem "normal" and required are not so in a society not trifled with the globalistic idealism of old. Now we do limited negotiations with whoever approaches us as well as we focus near entirely on our society and its needs.

focuses.name: Local Teachings For Local Needs
focuses.description: With us gutting the government, the next step is that of the government telling us what we can and can't teach our kids. This would obviously hurt centralized research efforts, but the prioritization of the welfare as well as the ensurance of survival of everyone is what should be the primary teachings of life itself.

focuses.name: The New Society
focuses.description: We have created a truly blessed and better society. Where the people can act as according their needs rather than the ever growing wants that modern globalism and consumerism has drilled into our minds. Now we set forth to our biggest goal ever. To proclaim our new society.

focuses.name: Proclaim The Free Territories
focuses.description: These once united states have now through trials and error, through unity beyond that needed for a state, have now formed a new path. We now can proudly proclaim our collective movement as the Free Territories of America. Now each and every person within these lands can enjoy their home, their family and their own lives without outside interference by governments and bad parties. Solidarity will be ours Forever.
